I'm Dr. Dave Candy, a board-certified specialist in orthopedic physical therapy and fellowship-trained orthopedic manual physical therapist, and my goal is to help people over 50 around the world stay active, mobile, and healthy without being held back by pain. 

Having been a physical therapist for 17 years, I've heard too many stories of people being told "You're just getting older. You're going to have to deal with the pain, take pills, or wait until it gets bad enough to have surgery."  But you've got a lot More Life to live after 50, and that's what this channel is all about! 

Check out my playlists to help back pain & sciatica, hip pain, knee pain, neck pain, and shoulder pain, plus tips to improve strength, balance, and mobility.

If you happen to live in the St. Louis, MO area I also have a physical therapy office in St. Louis. Visit online at https://m4lpt.com or call 314-941-3970 to request an appointment. If you live outside of St. Louis, visit https://overfiftycoach.com
